items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: He knew how to use Harry Carney on that baritone saxophone. I have watched different arrangements that sometimes Carney would be playing up above the tenor... I heard the saxophone section play a thing and he had Harry Carney playing up above the tenor

ctx.x: Only two. And the saxophones was Johnny Hodges and Harry Carney and --
